<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Thames Uni Connect — Your UK University Journey Starts Here</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:wght@400;600&family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root {
  --navy: #0F2D5E;
  --navy-mid: #1B4080;
  --blue-accent: #2563EB;
  --gold: #D4963A;
  --gold-light: #F5C842;
  --white: #FFFFFF;
  --off-white: #F8F7F4;
  --cream: #FDF9F2;
  --text-dark: #0D1B2A;
  --text-mid: #374151;
  --text-soft: #6B7280;
  --border: #E5E7EB;
  --green: #059669;
}
*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
body { font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; color: var(--text-dark); background: var(--white); overflow-x: hidden; }
h1,h2,h3 { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; }

/* NAV */
nav {
  position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 100;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 14px 48px;
  background: rgba(15,45,94,0.97);
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
}
.nav-logo { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; text-decoration: none; }
.nav-logo img { height: 44px; width: auto; object-fit: contain; mix-blend-mode: screen; }
.nav-links { display: flex; gap: 28px; list-style: none; }
.nav-links a { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75); text-decoration: none; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 400; transition: color 0.2s; }
.nav-links a:hover { color: var(--white); }
.nav-ctas { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
.btn-wa { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #25D366; color: white; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: opacity 0.2s; }
.btn-wa:hover { opacity: 0.88; }
.btn-primary { background: var(--gold); color: var(--navy); padding: 8px 18px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: all 0.2s; border: none; cursor: pointer; }
.btn-primary:hover { background: var(--gold-light); }

/* HERO */
.hero {
  min-height: 100vh;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0A1F3F 0%, #0F2D5E 50%, #1B4080 100%);
  display: flex; align-items: center;
  padding: 120px 48px 80px;
  position: relative; overflow: hidden;
}
.hero::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 70% 50%, rgba(212,150,58,0.12) 0%, transparent 60%);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.hero-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 420px; gap: 64px; max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; width: 100%; align-items: center; }
.hero-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: rgba(212,150,58,0.15); border: 1px solid rgba(212,150,58,0.4); color: var(--gold); padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 24px; }
.hero h1 { font-size: 52px; line-height: 1.15; color: var(--white); margin-bottom: 20px; }
.hero h1 em { color: var(--gold); font-style: normal; }
.hero-sub { font-size: 16px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.72); line-height: 1.75; margin-bottom: 36px; max-width: 520px; }
.hero-actions { display: flex; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 48px; }
.btn-hero { padding: 14px 28px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: all 0.2s; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.btn-hero-gold { background: var(--gold); color: var(--navy); }
.btn-hero-gold:hover { background: var(--gold-light); transform: translateY(-1px); }
.btn-hero-outline { border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3); color: white; }
.btn-hero-outline:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); }
.hero-stats { display: flex; gap: 32px; }
.hero-stat .num { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: 28px; color: var(--white); }
.hero-stat .label { font-size: 11px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); margin-top: 2px; }

/* HERO CARD */
.hero-card { background: var(--white); border-radius: 16px; padding: 32px; box-shadow: 0 24px 64px rgba(0,0,0,0.25); }
.hero-card-title { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: 18px; color: var(--navy); margin-bottom: 6px; }
.hero-card-sub { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-soft); margin-bottom: 24px; }
.form-group { margin-bottom: 14px; }
.form-group label { display: block; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-mid); margin-bottom: 5px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; }
.form-group select, .form-group input {
  width: 100%; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1.5px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px;
  font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-dark); background: var(--white);
  transition: border-color 0.2s; outline: none;
}
.form-group select:focus, .form-group input:focus { border-color: var(--blue-accent); }
.btn-form { width: 100%; background: var(--navy); color: white; padding: 13px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; border: none; cursor: pointer; margin-top: 8px; transition: all 0.2s; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; }
.btn-form:hover { background: var(--navy-mid); transform: translateY(-1px); }
.form-note { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-soft); text-align: center; margin-top: 10px; }

/* TRUST BAR */
.trust-bar {
  background: var(--off-white);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding: 16px 48px;
  display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 40px; flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.trust-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-mid); }
.trust-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--green); }

/* SECTION */
section { padding: 80px 48px; }
.section-label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.12em; color: var(--gold); margin-bottom: 12px; }
.section-title { font-size: 36px; color: var(--navy); margin-bottom: 14px; line-height: 1.2; }
.section-sub { font-size: 15px; color: var(--text-soft); line-height: 1.7; max-width: 520px; }
.section-header { margin-bottom: 48px; }
.section-header.centered { text-align: center; }
.section-header.centered .section-sub { margin: 0 auto; }

/* UNIVERSITIES */
.unis-section { background: var(--white); }
.unis-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr); gap: 14px; }
.uni-card {
  border: 1.5px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px 14px;
  text-align: center; background: var(--white); transition: all 0.2s; cursor: pointer;
}
.uni-card:hover { border-color: var(--navy); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(15,45,94,0.1); }
.uni-abbr { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: 22px; color: var(--navy); margin-bottom: 4px; }
.uni-name { font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-soft); line-height: 1.4; }

/* STEPS */
.steps-section { background: var(--navy); }
.steps-section .section-label { color: var(--gold); }
.steps-section .section-title { color: var(--white); }
.steps-section .section-sub { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.65); }
.steps-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 1fr); gap: 0; position: relative; }
.step-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; text-align: center; padding: 0 16px; position: relative; }
.step-item:not(:last-child)::after {
  content: '→';
  position: absolute; right: -8px; top: 20px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.25); font-size: 18px;
}
.step-icon { width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(212,150,58,0.15); border: 1.5px solid rgba(212,150,58,0.4); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin-bottom: 14px; font-size: 22px; }
.step-num { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: 11px; color: var(--gold); font-weight: 400; margin-bottom: 8px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; }
.step-name { font-size: 12px; color: var(--white); font-weight: 500; }

/* COURSES */
.courses-section { background: var(--cream); }
.courses-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 16px; }
.course-card {
  background: var(--white); border-radius: 12px; padding: 22px;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--border); transition: all 0.22s; cursor: pointer;
}
.course-card:hover { border-color: var(--navy); box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(15,45,94,0.1); }
.course-icon { font-size: 26px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.course-name { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--navy); margin-bottom: 6px; }
.course-careers { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-soft); line-height: 1.6; }
.career-tag { display: inline-block; background: var(--off-white); border: 1px solid var(--border); padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-mid); margin: 2px 2px 0 0; }

/* DESTINATIONS */
.destinations-section { background: var(--white); }
.dest-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 14px; }
.dest-card {
  border-radius: 14px; overflow: hidden; position: relative; cursor: pointer;
  height: 200px; border: 1px solid var(--border); transition: transform 0.2s;
}
.dest-card:first-child { grid-column: span 2; }
.dest-card:hover { transform: scale(1.01); }
.dest-bg {
  width: 100%; height: 100%;
  display: flex; align-items: flex-end; padding: 20px;
  position: relative;
}
.dest-uk { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1B3F7D 0%, #C8102E 100%); }
.dest-usa { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #B22234 0%, #3C3B6E 100%); }
.dest-ca { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FF0000 0%, #AA0000 100%); }
.dest-au { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00008B 0%, #006400 100%); }
.dest-nz { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #003087 0%, #CC0000 100%); }
.dest-eu { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #003399 0%, #FFCC00 80%); }
.dest-de { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #000 30%, #DD0000 65%, #FFCE00 100%); }
.dest-info { position: relative; z-index: 2; }
.dest-flag { font-size: 28px; display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; }
.dest-name { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; color: white; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; }
.dest-badge { font-size: 10px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); margin-top: 2px; }
.dest-primary-badge { background: var(--gold); color: var(--navy); font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 8px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; position: absolute; top: 12px; right: 12px; }

/* TESTIMONIALS */
.testimonials-section { background: var(--off-white); }
.testi-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 20px; }
.testi-card { background: var(--white); border-radius: 14px; padding: 28px; border: 1.5px solid var(--border); }
.testi-avatar { width: 46px; height: 46px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--navy); color: var(--gold); font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin-bottom: 16px; }
.testi-quote { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-mid); line-height: 1.75; margin-bottom: 18px; font-style: italic; }
.testi-name { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--navy); }
.testi-detail { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-soft); margin-top: 2px; }
.testi-uni { display: inline-block; margin-top: 8px; background: rgba(15,45,94,0.07); color: var(--navy); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 10px; }

/* ABOUT STRIP */
.about-strip {
  background: var(--cream);
  padding: 64px 48px;
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 64px; align-items: center;
  max-width: 100%;
}
.about-img-placeholder {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--navy) 0%, var(--navy-mid) 100%);
  border-radius: 16px; height: 340px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  color: white; font-size: 14px; text-align: center; padding: 32px;
  position: relative; overflow: hidden;
}
.about-img-placeholder::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  width: 200px; height: 200px;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(212,150,58,0.3), transparent);
  top: -20px; right: -20px;
  border-radius: 50%;
}
.about-quote { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: 20px; color: white; line-height: 1.5; position: relative; z-index: 1; }
.about-quote span { color: var(--gold); }
.cert-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: rgba(212,150,58,0.12); border: 1px solid rgba(212,150,58,0.3); padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 8px; margin-bottom: 20px; }
.cert-badge span { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--gold); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.07em; }

/* BLOG */
.blog-section { background: var(--white); }
.blog-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 20px; }
.blog-card { border: 1.5px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; transition: all 0.2s; }
.blog-card:hover { border-color: var(--navy); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); }
.blog-header { padding: 20px 20px 0; }
.blog-tag { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--gold); margin-bottom: 8px; }
.blog-title { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: 15px; color: var(--navy); line-height: 1.45; margin-bottom: 10px; }
.blog-excerpt { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-soft); line-height: 1.65; padding: 0 20px 20px; }
.blog-footer { padding: 12px 20px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-soft); display: flex; justify-content: space-between; }

/* CTA FINAL */
.cta-final {
  background: var(--navy);
  padding: 80px 48px;
  text-align: center; position: relative; overflow: hidden;
}
.cta-final::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 0%, rgba(212,150,58,0.15) 0%, transparent 65%);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.cta-final h2 { font-size: 40px; color: var(--white); margin-bottom: 14px; position: relative; }
.cta-final p { font-size: 15px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.65); margin-bottom: 36px; position: relative; }
.cta-buttons { display: flex; gap: 14px; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; position: relative; margin-bottom: 28px; }
.cta-contact { font-size: 13px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); position: relative; }
.cta-contact a { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75); }

/* INTAKES */
.intakes-bar {
  background: #F0F9FF; border-top: 3px solid var(--blue-accent); border-bottom: 1px solid #BFDBFE;
  padding: 18px 48px;
  display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 48px; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.intake-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.intake-dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; }
.intake-dot.active { background: var(--green); }
.intake-dot.upcoming { background: var(--gold); }
.intake-dot.secondary { background: #9CA3AF; }
.intake-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--navy); }
.intake-desc { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-soft); }

/* FOOTER */
footer {
  background: #080F1A; padding: 48px 48px 24px;
}
.footer-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 40px; margin-bottom: 40px; }
.footer-brand .brand-name { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: 18px; color: var(--white); margin-bottom: 8px; }
.footer-brand p { font-size: 12px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45); line-height: 1.7; max-width: 260px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
.footer-social { display: flex; gap: 10px; }
.social-btn { width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); font-size: 13px; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.2s; }
.social-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15); }
.footer-col h4 { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); margin-bottom: 14px; }
.footer-col a { display: block; font-size: 12px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); text-decoration: none; margin-bottom: 8px; transition: color 0.2s; }
.footer-col a:hover { color: var(--white); }
.footer-bottom { border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07); padding-top: 20px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; }
.footer-bottom p { font-size: 11px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3); }
.bc-cert { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--gold); }

/* WHATSAPP FLOAT */
.wa-float {
  position: fixed; bottom: 24px; right: 24px; z-index: 200;
  width: 54px; height: 54px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: #25D366; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(37,211,102,0.45);
  text-decoration: none; font-size: 26px;
  transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
}
.wa-float:hover { transform: scale(1.08); box-shadow: 0 6px 28px rgba(37,211,102,0.55); }

/* ANIMATIONS */
@keyframes fadeUp { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(24px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }
.hero-left > * { animation: fadeUp 0.6s ease forwards; opacity: 0; }
.hero-left > *:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0.1s; }
.hero-left > *:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.2s; }
.hero-left > *:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.3s; }
.hero-left > *:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 0.4s; }
.hero-left > *:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: 0.5s; }
.hero-card { animation: fadeUp 0.7s ease 0.35s forwards; opacity: 0; }

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  nav { padding: 12px 20px; }
  .nav-links { display: none; }
  .hero { padding: 100px 20px 60px; }
  .hero-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .hero h1 { font-size: 34px; }
  section { padding: 60px 20px; }
  .unis-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
  .courses-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
  .dest-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
  .dest-card:first-child { grid-column: span 2; }
  .testi-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .about-strip { grid-template-columns: 1fr; padding: 48px 20px; }
  .blog-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
  .trust-bar { gap: 16px; padding: 14px 20px; }
  .intakes-bar { padding: 14px 20px; gap: 20px; }
  .steps-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 20px; }
}
</style>
</head>

        <div class="hero-stat"><div class="num">Free</div><div class="label">End-to-End Service</div></div>
      </div>

    <div class="hero-card" id="book">
      <div class="hero-card-title">Request a Free Consultation</div>

        <label>Country of Residence</label>

      <div class="blog-header">
        <div class="blog-tag">UK Student Visa</div>
        <div class="blog-title">UK Student Visa — Requirements, Costs & How to Apply</div>
      </div>
      <p class="blog-excerpt">To study in the UK you need a Student visa if your course is longer than 6 months. You'll need a CAS from your university, proof of English (IELTS 4.5–6.5 depending on course), and financial evidence. The visa fee is £363 from outside the UK.</p>
      <div class="blog-footer">
        <span>Official Source</span>
        <a href="https://www.gov.uk/student-visa" target="_blank" rel="noopener" style="color:var(--navy);text-decoration:none;font-weight:500;">Gov.uk →</a>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="blog-card">
      <div class="blog-header">
        <div class="blog-tag">Post-Study Work</div>
        <div class="blog-title">Graduate Route Visa — Stay & Work in the UK for 2 Years After Your Degree</div>
      </div>
      <p class="blog-excerpt">The Graduate visa allows international students who have completed a UK degree to live and work — or look for work — in the UK for up to 2 years (3 years for PhD graduates). No sponsor needed. Apply online for £822.</p>
      <div class="blog-footer">
        <span>Official Source</span>
        <a href="https://www.gov.uk/graduate-visa" target="_blank" rel="noopener" style="color:var(--navy);text-decoration:none;font-weight:500;">Gov.uk →</a>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="blog-card">
      <div class="blog-header">
        <div class="blog-tag">Scholarships</div>
        <div class="blog-title">UK Government Scholarships for International Students</div>
      </div>
      <p class="blog-excerpt">The Chevening Scholarship, Commonwealth Scholarships, and GREAT Scholarships are among the major UK government-funded awards available to international students. Many universities also offer their own bursaries and payment plans.</p>
      <div class="blog-footer">
        <span>Official Source</span>
        <a href="https://www.chevening.org" target="_blank" rel="noopener" style="color:var(--navy);text-decoration:none;font-weight:500;">Chevening.org →</a>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
